name: session-instructions-loader
description: Codex-only SessionStart hook that injects ancestor AGENTS.md files and repo-configured instruction files.

interface.shortDescription: Injects extra instructions on startup, resume, clear, and compact
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex SessionStart hook that runs on startup, resume, clear, and post-compaction sources. When configured with ancestorLevel, it can read AGENTS.md files from parent directories above the repository root, resolves Git worktrees through the original repository root, and loads repo-configured extra instruction files from .codex/session-instructions-loader.json.
defaultPrompt: Load additional session instructions for this workspace.
